summary.text: Justin Gerhardt is a Republican member of the North Dakota Senate, representing District 34 (home city listed as Mandan), serving since 2023 per the legislature's member page.

paragraphs.text: The legislature's biography for Gerhardt lists an occupation of Construction Manager.
It lists education as BS, Construction Engineering, NDSU.
It also lists Iraq War Veteran and ND Army National Guard (1997-2006).
Family is listed as: Married (Maren); 4 children.
For the 2025 regular session, the page lists Gerhardt's standing committee assignments as Education and Energy and Natural Resources.
